content.short: Merlin is a smart DeFi portfolio tracker with institutional-grade DeFi position reporting.
content.description: Merlin streamlines portfolio monitoring by tracking DeFi positions and presenting them in an accessible interface. It delivers in-depth analysis of key performance metrics—yield, USD P&L, and impermanent loss—along with historical transaction data and market information at pool and protocol levels. The free interface is available to all users and includes open APIs, while a paid API option is available for users who require more granular data and advanced access.
